summary: A negotiator asks to have an accountant check {employer}'s claim that a raise would threaten the business.
realLife: When Truitt said it lacked the means to grant the requested raise, the union asked to let a certified accountant examine company records and then sought information supporting that position.
gates: The case record identifies the employer's inability-to-pay claim and union's request.
inGame: needs: employer's inability-to-pay claim and union's request.

turns.what: The union can reassess the demand.
The representative preserves the request and response.
